# Who's On First: a Cloud-Native Gazetteer

> Who's On First, the open gazetteer, as geocode.earth distributes it, with
> the few files a browser needs to search it. 5,405,294 named administrative
> places from country down to microhood, six boundary collections plus a
> 9,478,779-row name index sorted for prefix search. Static files on object
> storage, no API, no credentials. Produced by Who's On First; distributed by
> geocode.earth; this catalog describes and extends, it does not produce.

Public root:
https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/catalog.json

**This is place-name and boundary lookup, not address geocoding.** Who's On
First's administrative distribution holds no street and no house number.

This is a Portolan catalog, which is STAC 1.1.0 plus the Portolan profile.
Every file is readable in place over HTTPS range requests. Seven collections,
each with a collection.json, a README.md for humans, an AGENTS.md for machine
clients, GeoParquet, PMTiles and measured MapLibre styles.

## A metadata-first catalog

Unusually for a mirror, this catalog does **not** copy the upstream bytes.
geocode.earth's own files are already cloud-native, so every collection links
straight to them — GeoParquet, PMTiles, SQLite, SpatiaLite, GeoJSON bundle —
with the size and sha256 their inventory records.

What it builds is only what a measurement says those files cannot do:

1. One GeoParquet per level with small row groups. From the upstream combined
   file, one place's geometry costs a median of 38 MiB and up to 285 MiB,
   because it has 83 row groups of 65,536 rows and 89% of its bytes in one
   column.
2. A display-simplified companion for levels 0 to 3, and not for 4 and 5,
   where the median feature is a single point.
3. PMTiles capped at 400 KB per tile. The upstream archive is built with
   `--no-tile-size-limit` and its whole-world tile is 15,671,392 bytes.
4. A name index, which has no upstream equivalent in any format.

Every deviation and every measurement is in
https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/changes-from-upstream.md

## License: a mix, attribution required, no share-alike

Who's On First scopes CC0 to "the format and structure that allows Who's On
First to operate" — the schema, not the records — and the records inherit
terms from over 300 sources. The STAC `license` is therefore `other` with
license links, not an SPDX identifier.

Measured on the distribution's own `geom_src` column: 70.88% of the geometry
is GeoNames under CC BY, 2.58% is CC0, and 14 records of 5,423,663 are
share-alike. No ODbL source contributes geometry.

Show this:

    Data from Who's On First. License: https://whosonfirst.org/docs/licenses/

`geom_src` is on every row of every boundary file. Join it to
https://github.com/whosonfirst/whosonfirst-sources and a specific place's
license is a fact rather than an average.

## Collections

Who's On First has no administrative level number. `level` is this catalog's
mapping of WOF placetypes onto a 0-based ladder, and a level is a *tier* that
can hold a unit and its own subdivision.

- [country](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/country/collection.json):
  level 0, 353 places — `country`, `dependency`, `disputed`.
- [region](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/region/collection.json):
  level 1, 4,362 places — `macroregion`, `region`.
- [county](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/county/collection.json):
  level 2, 42,115 places — `macrocounty`, `county`.
- [localadmin](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/localadmin/collection.json):
  level 3, 164,756 places — `localadmin`.
- [locality](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/locality/collection.json):
  level 4, 4,796,292 places — `locality`, `borough`.
- [neighbourhood](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/neighbourhood/collection.json):
  level 5, 397,416 places — `macrohood`, `neighbourhood`, `microhood`.
- [names](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/names/collection.json):
  the gazetteer index, 9,478,779 rows (5,405,294 places + 4,073,485
  alternative spellings), sorted by a folded form of the name.

## Data files

- .../country/wof_country.parquet, .../country/wof_country_display.parquet
- .../region/wof_region.parquet, .../region/wof_region_display.parquet
- .../county/wof_county.parquet, .../county/wof_county_display.parquet
- .../localadmin/wof_localadmin.parquet, .../localadmin/wof_localadmin_display.parquet
- .../locality/wof_locality.parquet
- .../neighbourhood/wof_neighbourhood.parquet
- .../names/wof_names.parquet, .../names/index.json
- one `.pmtiles` per collection

all under
https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/

The `*_display.parquet` files exist only for levels 0 to 3, and are
**buffered outward on purpose**, so neighbours overlap. Draw and filter with
them; measure and clip with the full-resolution files.

## Start a query

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- Everything called Kyoto, in any of the 25 languages this index carries.
SELECT name, name_lang, level, placetype, country, parent_name, population
FROM 'https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog/names/wof_names.parquet'
WHERE name_norm = 'kyoto'
ORDER BY level, population DESC NULLS LAST;
```

## The things that produce wrong answers

1. `level` is this catalog's mapping, not WOF's. WOF has placetypes, not
   levels.
2. 84% of localities and neighbourhoods are **points**, not polygons, because
   most come from GeoNames. Check `vertices = 1`, or `is_point` in the index.
3. `parent_id` is not always an identifier: WOF reserves `-1`, `-2`, `-3` and
   `-4` as sentinels, and this build maps only `-1` to null.
4. **Nothing here says whether a place still exists.** `mz:is_current`,
   `edtf:cessation`, `edtf:deprecated` and `wof:superseded_by` are not in the
   GeoParquet distribution.
5. The index carries 25 languages. Who's On First carries hundreds; they are
   in the SQLite and GeoJSON distributions.
6. The GeoParquet vintage is 2025-04-07, six months behind the SQLite,
   SpatiaLite, GeoJSON and PMTiles builds of the same repository. HTTP
   `Last-Modified` is not a vintage signal upstream.
7. The full `wof:hierarchy` and `wof:concordances` are not here: this
   distribution keeps three ancestor-id columns and **one** concordance pair.
8. An alternative-spelling row in the index repeats its place's `feature_id`.
   Dedupe on it, or the same city appears once per language.
9. `geometry_ref` is advisory. Verify the `wof_id` of the row it points at
   before trusting that row's geometry.

## Optional

- [geocode.earth's combined Who's On First
  downloads](https://geocode.earth/data/whosonfirst/combined/): the upstream
  distribution, plus the per-country and per-placetype alternatives.
- [Who's On First placetypes](https://github.com/whosonfirst/whosonfirst-placetypes):
  the project's own definitions, which are more current than its website.
- [Who's On First licenses](https://whosonfirst.org/docs/licenses/) and
  [whosonfirst-sources](https://github.com/whosonfirst/whosonfirst-sources):
  the per-source licensing, and the key `geom_src` resolves against.
- [geoboundaries-catalog](https://source.coop/portolan-mirrors/geoboundaries-catalog):
  a CC-BY-4.0 sibling gazetteer catalog, same index contract, stops at the
  second administrative level.
- [cn-gazetteer-overture](https://source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-gazetteer-overture):
  an ODbL sibling, same index contract, hundreds of languages, share-alike.
- [Source
  repository](https://github.com/portolan-mirrors/whosonfirst-catalog): the
  pipeline, the upstream and index measurements, the licensing evidence, and
  the issue tracker.
- [Portolan specification](https://github.com/portolan-sdi/portolan-spec):
  what this catalog conforms to.
